The following Base Prospectus has been approved by the United Kingdom Financial Conduct Authority and is available for viewing:
Base Prospectus dated 07 October 2026 (the "Base Prospectus") relating to the Secured Cryptoasset Linked Securities Programme of iShares Digital Assets AG.

Subject to certain exceptions, the Securities may not at any time be offered, sold or delivered in the United States, as defined in Regulation S under the Securities Act. The Base Prospectus may not be accessed from, or transmitted in or into, the United States.
